name: Inp-Video Ads Lite
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Inp-Video Ads Lite is a powerful lead generation tool that allows you to display a floating video widget on your WordPress website. Through an interactive video bubble (video popup), you can present a personalized recorded message to your visitors and provide a direct “Click to Chat” button for them to contact you via WhatsApp.

Stand out from the competition! Instead of a standard static chat icon, engage your audience with a face-to-face video greeting. This direct communication channel is proven to build trust, increase sales, and improve customer support on any website, including WooCommerce stores, blogs, and corporate landing pages.

Lite Version Features

  • Floating Video Widget: A sleek video bubble that displays your custom .mp4 video perfectly on the screen.
  • WhatsApp Integration: Includes a highly visible “Click to Chat” button that connects visitors directly to your WhatsApp number.
  • Lead Generation: Turn anonymous traffic into real WhatsApp contacts effortlessly.
  • Global Display: The video widget appears seamlessly across all pages of your WordPress site.
  • Performance-Oriented: Uses native HTML5 video tags, loads asynchronously, and is highly optimized to maintain your site’s load speed (Core Web Vitals friendly).
  • Customizable CTA: Modify the call-to-action (CTA) button text to fit your marketing strategy.
  • Page Builder Friendly: Works perfectly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other major page builders.

For advanced features like multi-video support, specific page targeting, analytics, and custom branding colors, visit the official page at inp-web.com/inpvideo.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inp-video-ads-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Inp-Video Lite” section in your dashboard side menu to configure your video URL and WhatsApp number.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce and Elementor?

Yes! Inp-Video Ads Lite is fully compatible with WooCommerce, Elementor, Gutenberg, and all major WordPress themes and page builders.

Will the floating video slow down my website load time?

No. The plugin is strictly designed with performance in mind. It loads asynchronously and uses native HTML5 video tags to ensure it does not negatively impact your page speed or Core Web Vitals.

What video format and size should I use?

We highly recommend using a web-optimized .mp4 format. For the best user experience and fast loading times, keep your video file size under 3MB to 5MB, preferably without an audio track if you only want visual engagement in the background.

How does the WhatsApp button work?

When a user clicks the customizable Call-to-Action (CTA) button inside the expanded video popup, it automatically redirects them to a WhatsApp chat with the phone number you configured in the admin panel. It works flawlessly on both desktop (WhatsApp Web) and mobile devices (WhatsApp App).

Can I use this for customer support?

Absolutely! Adding a welcome video explaining your services and offering a direct WhatsApp chat is one of the most effective ways to provide personalized customer support and increase your conversion rate.

Can I change the text on the WhatsApp button?

Yes, the Lite version allows you to easily customize the CTA text (e.g., “Chat with us”, “Get a Free Quote”, “Talk on WhatsApp”) directly from the plugin’s settings panel.

How can I show different videos on specific pages?

The Lite version displays one global video across your entire site. For advanced targeting (showing specific videos on checkout pages, specific blog posts, or landing pages), you can upgrade to the PRO version.
